Product name:Bentonite cat litter
Scent：Lemon   Lavender   Apple  Coffee   Rose    Peach   Original   Talcum Powder
Weight of each bag:2 kg

Advantages of bentonite cat litter:
1. Easy to handle, convenient and safe for family use;
2. Long lasting effect;
3. Super fast moisture absorption, which can quickly absorb the water in urine and feces discharged by pets in a very short time; The moisture absorption reaches more than 80% of its own weight while still keeping the appearance dry.

How to treat bentonite cat litter after use?
After using bentonite cat litter, many people often put it into the toilet for convenience. If the amount is large, it is easy to block the toilet, which brings us a lot of trouble. The main reason is that the bentonite cat litter has a strong water absorption capacity, which expands many times after absorbing water, so it is easy to block the toilet pipe. It is very troublesome to handle. The correct way to dispose the used cat litter is to put the waste cat litter into a plastic bag and put it into a non recyclable dustbin.
